analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited discussed its Q1 FY27 financial performance and business strategy during its earnings call on July 31, 2026. Management raised its revenue guidance for FY27 to between INR 325 crore and INR 350 crore, supported by growth in its core business and branch network expansion. The company is actively scaling its hybrid model by developing and launching its digital platform, AkikoPay. Management confirmed that there are no immediate fundraising plans for the next six months to one year. Akiko Global Services Limited presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, highlighting robust revenue growth and strong operational momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending distribution businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upward to between INR 325 crore and INR 350 crore.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining a 70% to 100% year-on-year CAGR over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management aims to reach monthly loan disbursements of around INR 1,000 crores by December.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management remains comfortable with achieving around INR 50 crores in revenue from AkikoPay by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, I can see that we would be able to achieve this particular number you are saying by FY27 end.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth of 70% to 100% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a long-term vision to reach INR1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR50 crores of revenue from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR1,000 crores of unsecured book by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be around INR65 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management set a target of reaching 5 million customers by September 30th and 1 million customers by December 31st.
guidance.quote: I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans represent the fastest-growing loan product segment for the company.
Monthly loan disbursement currently stands at around INR 450 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: And now we are at around 450-odd.

demand_outlook.claim: AkikoPay receives between 200 and 300 credit leads on a daily average.
demand_outlook.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's core offline business distribution is increasing by 4% to 7% month-on-month.
demand_outlook.quote: because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that physical presence in cities significantly boosts customer conversion rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that banks are more aggressive in March for financial product sales compared to the start of the new financial year in April.
demand_outlook.quote: Because every bank's balance sheet has closed in March and after closing aggressively, they are a little cool down in the first month of starting the New Financial Year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that about 10% to 12% of users complete KYC for the INR2 lakh limit, while most prefer the controlled INR10,000 limit.
demand_outlook.quote: See, I am seeing that only 10% to 12% people are doing KYC for 2 lakh limit. They are more interested in 10,000 limit.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have 25 branches. For DSAs, there are no separate ones because we don't do hard calling or hard selling under DSAs. So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: All branch locations operated by the company are taken on rent or lease.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad, with plans to open new branches in Indore and Kerala over the next 2-3 months.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones. Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities, and customer experience.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities and customer experience while maintaining a disciplined approach towards scalable and profitable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported expanding company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that branch presence has increased from three or four branches in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: The company's average payout in unsecured disbursements is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Receivable days dropped to 110 days from 133 days and are projected to fall below 90 days in Q2.
margins_costs.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates PAT margin expanding to 12%-14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
margins_costs.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay operates with approximately 40% lower customer acquisition costs compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: Targeted cashback of around 1% is used to drive user acquisition, activation, and transaction frequency on AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: Targeted cashback (~1%) driving user acquisition, activation, and transaction frequency

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay has negligible customer acquisition costs due to leveraging existing employees and database.
margins_costs.quote: We are not burning any single penny on AkikoPay because we have made a huge empire, we have 1,500 employees, we have a database of 25 million, so we are going to monetize that. So, with that, negligible type of expenses will be occurred there.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the 1% cashback strategy is sustainable for the next year supported by a 1.8% MDR and zero customer acquisition expenses.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, this sustainability for next one year will be live because right now we are getting around 1.8% MDR and we are not putting any expense to acquire customer. So this 1% strategy for open market strategy, 1% cashback entices customers to come on our AkikoPay.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an overall employee strength of approximately 950 people.
orders_capacity.quote: In the investor deck, it has been mentioned that the employee strength is around odd 950.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disburses approximately 18,000 credit cards monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: And if I calculate for our 18,000 cards, it comes to around INR6 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore and monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The AkikoPay Android application reached over 30,000 downloads.
orders_capacity.quote: 30K+ Android app downloads reflecting strong initial adoption

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay recorded 9,000 monthly active users and 1,000 daily active users.
orders_capacity.quote: MAU (Monthly Active User): 9K | DAU (Daily Active User): 1K, indicating consistent early-stage platform activity

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR400 crores+, representing an annualized book of INR5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay achieved 57,000 downloads so far on Android.
orders_capacity.quote: So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans to raise funds for the next 6 to 12 months as bank CC limits are well aligned.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Total revenue from the Dubai business was limited to INR 1.25 crores in Q1 due to geopolitical conflict.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin and revenue pressure due to geopolitical issues around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to achieving INR 325 crore to INR 350 crore in revenue for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to delivering a PAT margin between 9% and 11% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving monthly loan disbursements of around INR 1,000 crores by December.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve around INR 50 crores of revenue from AkikoPay by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, I can see that we would be able to achieve this particular number you are saying by FY27 end.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident in meeting its revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore for FY27 along with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is expected to offer a comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within the month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the MD or CEO position decision will be taken soon and he will be seen as MD in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
